name: scoring_rules
description: Central scoring configuration. Controls how different factors contribute to job fit scoring. Must remain transparent and not contain hidden rejection logic.

calibration_notes.design: Narrow requirement-fit scoring. The LLM extracts per-requirement coverage (status, importance, mapped capability/eligibility) from the job description; the score is the weighted percentage of requirement_importance_weights satisfied by candidate capability_level_weights and requirement_status_weights credit, adjusted by requirement_fit_entries. There is no LLM-grade base score or grade band clamping — the requirement fit percentage IS the score before hard-block penalties.
calibration_notes.requirement_importance_weights: Per-requirement weight by importance (mandatory, strongly_preferred, preferred, bonus) used to compute the weighted percentage of requirements satisfied.
calibration_notes.capability_level_weights: Credit multiplier applied to a requirement's weight based on the candidate's matched capability level (strong, working, basic, low, limited_depth) for that requirement.
calibration_notes.requirement_status_weights: Credit multiplier applied to a requirement's weight based on whether support is direct (`supported`) or partial (`partially_supported`).
calibration_notes.hard_blockers: Applied on top of the requirement-fit percentage. A single hard blocker subtracts 100, forcing the score to near-zero regardless of requirement fit.

fit_breakdown.description: Hard-block penalty applied on top of the requirement-fit percentage. Internal scoring logic.

requirement_importance_weights.description: Per-requirement weight by importance used to compute the weighted percentage of requirements satisfied.

capability_level_weights.description: Credit multiplier applied to a requirement's weight based on the candidate's matched capability level for that requirement.

requirement_status_weights.description: Credit multiplier applied to a requirement's weight based on whether support is direct or partial.

convergence.description: Bonuses for strong multi-signal agreement between title, content, and evidence.
convergence.label: Multiple strong signals align

competitive_signal_alignment.description: Score adjustments for competitive signals that point toward a specialist domain.

work_mode.description: Score adjustment for a confirmed selected work mode. Multiple selected modes are neutral.

salary.description: Score adjustments for salary or rate fit.

location.description: Score adjustments for location fit and travel distance.

contract.description: Score adjustments for selected work-type preference, including Permanent, Contract, and FTC, plus contract-length confidence where relevant.

government.description: Score adjustments for sector matches using public-sector context evidence.

evidence_tier_weights.description: Managed defaults for profile support tier weighting. These correspond to the profile-side support weighting controls in Advanced Settings.

preference_weight_defaults.description: Managed defaults for the profile-side weight sliders shown in Advanced Settings.

occupation_alignment.description: Deterministic score adjustment applied on top of requirement fit, based on the LLM-classified occupation alignment between the job and the candidate's target roles. The LLM classifies same/adjacent/different only; this file owns the numeric adjustment.

deterministic_review_thresholds.description: Controls the pre-LLM deterministic KEEP-candidate shortcut in source_learning.deterministic_review_outcome. This shortcut must not reject ambiguous jobs; anything that is not a confident KEEP candidate continues to the full LLM fit review and requirement_coverage before any final KEEP is saved. To calibrate, filter audit_records.json on det_rule and inspect the final review_source and requirement_coverage fields.

field_descriptions.min_strong_signals_for_strong_keep: Minimum strong fit signals to mark a KEEP candidate that still requires full LLM requirement review before final KEEP. Lower to route more confident jobs through the LLM review path.
field_descriptions.min_strong_signals_for_solid_keep: Minimum strong fit signals to mark a KEEP candidate for the SOLID path. Must be below min_strong_signals_for_strong_keep.
field_descriptions.max_medium_risks_for_solid_keep: Maximum soft-risk count allowed for the SOLID KEEP candidate shortcut to fire. Raise to route more borderline jobs into full LLM review.

role_defining_gap_control.description: Generic guard against high scores driven by routine duties when the candidate lacks the specialist requirement cluster that defines the role.
